note: Every time in the plan, in milliseconds unless it says beats. "ease" names: out = fast then slow, in = slow then fast, back = overshoots by 10% then settles.

beat.note: Unchanged from the build: the beat clock of version 2 stays.

star_for_a_word.start: the middle of the sign's word plank

gate1_lift_off.starts: when the sheep passes the middle of gateFarm

steps.what: every ground mesh of world 1 (snow, banks, ripples, wall, mill hill, far hills, pond, low props) sinks 9 m
the underside of every track bay (soil, stone teeth, icicles, roots) grows down from the snow top (scale y 0 to 1, pinned at the top)
the fence posts and rails fall 6 m and turn 40 degrees; the string of bulbs stays
under each building and tree an island grows down (scale y 0 to 1, pinned at the top); row B2 first, B3 100 ms later, B4 200 ms later
each island moves from y 0.1 to its world 2 height
the sheets of the northern light rise one after another, left to right, 16 ms apart, each over 300 ms
the snow turns and begins to rise
sky colours, haze colour and lights go from world 1 to world 2
the moon fills from crescent to full, one column of cells every 40 ms

gate2_tucked_in.starts: when the sheep passes the first post of gateFootboard

steps.what: a wave runs along the lane from the footboard at 16 m a second; where it passes, each track bay changes from laneBayFloat to laneBayBed (120 ms, the new bay rising 0.3 m into place)
behind the same wave the lining band slides in from the back (z -5.2 to -1.2) and each quilt square pops up (scale y 0, 1.15, 1 over 220 ms), nearest rows first, each row 40 ms after the row before
every island sinks 12 m and is removed
the sheets of the northern light shrink upward and fade
the buttons drop down their threads to their places, one every 60 ms, each with one small bounce
the candle rises from behind the far folds
sky colours, haze colour and lights go from world 2 to world 3; the moon grows from 128 to 190 px across
the snow stops; feathers begin to fall

gate3_he_turns_over.starts: when the sheep passes the second post of gateHeadboard

steps.what: a wave runs along the lane at 16 m a second; where it passes, each track bay changes from laneBayBed to the snowy track of world 1 and the quilt squares drop flat (scale y 1 to 0, 180 ms)
world 1's ground rises 9 m into place, with its fence, wall and farm
the buttons are pulled up their threads; the candle sinks behind the far folds
sky colours, haze colour and lights go from world 3 to world 1; the moon shrinks from 190 to 96 px and its right side empties to a crescent
in the bed strip the farmer rolls onto his other side and back (pose bedTurn), once

moon_show.starts: when the count reaches 10, 20, 30 and every further 10

steps_beats.what: the moon grows to 1.6 times its size in that world; in world 1 the crescent also fills to a full disc

ten small sheep (the game's own sheep model, drawn unlit in ink 0, each a fifth of the moon's width long) hop across the moon from left to right, one starting every half beat from beat 1; each crossing takes 1.5 beats and rises by a fifth of the moon's width in the middle; the last lands at beat 7
the moon returns to its size (and, in world 1, to a crescent)

world2_motion.island_bob: y + 0.18 * sin(2*pi*beats/8 + phase), phase = 0, 2.1 or 4.2 by bob group

world3_motion.button_flip: one half turn about its thread over 300 ms; button i flips on beat 4*k + (i mod 4)
world3_motion.candle_flicker: plus or minus 15%, 0.5 to 1.5 times a second, never a blink

world1_motion.bulb_chase: bulb i is at full glow when (i + whole beats) mod 4 is 0, otherwise at 45%
world1_motion.windmill: one eighth of a turn per beat, each step over 120 ms
world1_motion.chimney: three snow:2 cubes of 0.1 m every second beat, rising 1.2 m over 1.6 s and shrinking to nothing

reduced_motion: Gates cut over in a 200 ms fade. No bob, wave, flip, roll, pulse or moon show; the count still pops. The sheep, the obstacles and the track move as the game needs.
